snippet.title: Koji Hero Spotlight | Heart Electric
snippet.description:
"Koji belongs to the Gen-2 Gamma Series and is one of the few Synths of that generation to break Body Protocol and accept non-human limb replacement. It was discovered during his early Wind training that a large part of his Sub World had dominant Traces of - somewhat surprisingly - baseball. This proficiency quickly became Koji’s favorite battle technique, and his arm enhancement was adopted.

Koji lives life to the maximum. Restless and with a burning intensity, he wants to get straight to the action and enjoy the ride. He was always naturally drawn to fire, and this has become his signum.

If you can take the heat and keep up, Koji is the best mate you’ll ever have."

Heart Electric is a fast-paced, 4-team Hero FPS in development by new Swedish studio Modoyo, breathing new life into the competitive shooter genre. A fresh resource-stealing game mode, freedom of movement and endless possibilities to outsmart or cooperate with other teams.

Wishlist on Steam and sign up to Playtest: https://bit.ly/4esdRJg
Join the Discord: https://discord.com/invite/heart-electric

More details on our website: https://modoyo.com/heartelectric
